story.blurb: Emmett finally confronts Seth about the junk stashed in the ship's navigation system, and Seth answers with the airlock. What follows leaves him adrift, armed and facing the Llamanians.

lines.text: Emmett was pissed. He had just gotten back from the food court at a nearby space station when he realized an error in the ship's navigational system. Acceleration and liftoff were fine, but the general steering and pathfinding of the ship were off. Emmett would have been fine with this happening had the crew owned their ship for a GUY or so, however the ship was only a few weeks out from the stockrooms of Fleetshup-7. The Squoatling underwent the tedious process of unscrewing the double screws (screws embedded in screws) of the navigational panel and checked around for any broken fuses. Instead, he was met with a nice surprise.
"Oh, fucking hell."

segments.text: Oh, fucking hell.

lines.text: In the compartment, a mess was stowed. Dirty tissues, used condoms, rings, physical Ducketts, and other objects of vice revealed themselves. In the place where the navigation and pathfinding fuses used to be, two packets of liquid cheese were found. This was the last straw. Emmett stood up from his kneeling position and stomped his way to the captain's quarters.
"Seth! Get out here right this instant!" There was no response, even after multiple requests.

lines.text: The Kid felt paralyzed and dizzy. He wasn't used to actually being in space, let alone uncontrollably drifting within it. He was also afraid he was going to puke from the head rush he was receiving. His experience was fading quickly. Rather than being upset at Seth, he soon became bored. There was quite literally nothing he could do. With no forces holding him down, he was doomed.

That was, until he saw a ship in the distance. It was not his own, but rather, a small cruiser. The vehicle was dashing towards him, to the point that he felt as if they were bound to save him. Alas, this was not the case. The small passenger ship sped past him within feet of his face, causing him to yaw clockwise. Now he was spinning on two separate planes. Delightful. It wasn't much longer until a fleet sprouted from behind the ship, obviously in pursuit. His hopes came up again. Of all the ships chasing the getaway, one of them slowed down to accommodate Emmett's position. He was rescued. With the use of a tractor beam, the Squoatling was dragged to safety.
Upon entering the ship, Emmett immediately fell to the floor. His now increased weight due to his bugsuit along with his newfound gravity caused him to drop.
